data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter client for openrouteservice directions, isochrones, matrices, and geocoding.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed request and response models for the openrouteservice API. Allows developers to generate directions, calculate isochrones and time-distance matrices, perform Pelias geocoding, fetch elevation and points of interest, and solve routing optimizations.
use_when: You need to integrate openrouteservice routing, directions, or geocoding into a Dart or Flutter application
You need to fetch elevation or calculate travel time-distance matrices
avoid_when: You require an offline mapping and routing solution
You are using a routing provider other than openrouteservice
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of openrouteservice API endpoints
Typed request and response models for all features
weaknesses: Requires an external API key and active internet connection
Tied specifically to the openrouteservice backend
data.setup_notes: Requires an openrouteservice API key obtained from their developer portal.
